record.question: Which of the following is taken as the Standard Meridian of India?
record.explanation: Answer B: 82°E 30E. India’s standard meridian is 82°30′ east longitude. Reference: https://surveyofindia.gov.in/pages/time-zone. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
